summary.zh: 定位慢接口、内存泄漏与 CPU 峰值
summary.en: Find slow endpoints, memory leaks and CPU spikes with real numbers.

description.zh: 对 Node.js、Python 或 Go 服务先测量再优化，用火焰图、内存快照和压测数据定位瓶颈，改完再测一遍对比。适合接口变慢、内存持续上涨、包体积超标等场景。压测需要能本地启动服务并安装依赖。
description.en: Measures before optimizing: flamegraphs, snapshots and load tests find the bottleneck, then a second run shows the gain. Covers slow endpoints, memory growth and oversized bundles in Node.js, Python or Go. Load tests need a running service.
